words.ur: میرا بیٹا پڑھائی میں کیسا ہے؟
words.roman: Mera beta parhai mein kaisa hai?

text.ur: بچوں کے اسکول میں ٹیچر سے بات کرتے وقت یہ جملے کام آئیں گے: 'I am Ahmed's father' (میں احمد کا والد ہوں)، 'How is he doing in class?' (کلاس میں کیسا ہے؟)۔ بچہ نہ جا سکے تو: 'My son is sick today. He will be absent.'۔
text.roman: Bachon ke school mein teacher se baat karte waqt yeh jumle kaam aaein ge: 'I am Ahmed's father' (main Ahmed ka waalid hoon), 'How is he doing in class?' (class mein kaisa hai?). Bachcha na ja sake to: 'My son is sick today. He will be absent.'.

examples.en: How is she doing in class?

exercises.say: Hello! How can I help you?
options: Hi, I am Ali's mother. How is he doing in class?

exercises.say: He needs to do his homework every day.
options: He needs to do his homework every day.
He needs to do his housework every day.
She needs to do her homework every day.

q.en: My daughter will be ___ tomorrow. She has a fever.

q.ur: میں تین بجے اسے لینے آؤں گا
q.roman: Main teen bajay use lene aaunga

why.ur: 'My son' کے بعد دوبارہ 'he' نہ لگائیں۔
why.roman: 'My son' ke baad dobara 'he' na lagaein.
